chunks: And whatever is in it from Salamah ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, I have narrated it from my father and Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with them both—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Salamah ibn al-Khaṭṭāb al-Barāwistānī.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; one of the author's named transmitters in this sanad/isnad.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct authorial reporting of the narration through a stated chain.
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A transmitter named in the sanad/isnad through whom the report passes.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain of Shaykh al-Ṣadūq to Salamah ibn al-Khaṭṭāb in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Salamah ibn al-Khaṭṭāb. It serves as a chain-clarification notice in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh, identifying the intermediaries between the compiler and that narrator.
